messages.body:
Hi Dan,

Thanks for volunteering! You're down to organize the bake sale stall for the school fair on {{date:2026-09-19|%-d %B}}. That means recruiting 3-4 parent helpers, arranging who bakes what, sorting a float for the cash box, and picking up the table from the caretaker the day before.

No rush to reply -- just make sure it's all sorted by early {{date:2026-09-01|%B}}.

Best,
Lakeside PTA
